activity_summary: A crust at the Jackdaw started the tooth on the left side, below, and you put the bread down. Pope asked where it pained, and you told him here. Burbage offered a royal progress to the barber. Agnes, who has buried two husbands, offered a clove or a hot knitting-needle. You chose the clove.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Put the bread down, pointed, and chose the clove.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Asked where it pained, and got a place.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Offered a royal progress to the barber, and was refused.

entities.name: Agnes Tipping
entities.context: Named the clove and the hot knitting-needle, and did not heat the needle.

quotes.speaker: thomas_pope
quotes.text: Where does it pain you today, Will?

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: For once, where I say. Here.

quotes.speaker: agnes_tipping
quotes.text: A clove, held on it. Or a hot knitting-needle
